feature_semantics: Standardized z-scores*100 from a pinned upstream meteorological baseline, directions for deterministic test only; source and baseline not implemented
time_gate: Each forecast component must have issue_time and available_time <= model evaluation issue; valid_target=issue+horizon. Observations also available <= issue

sources.role: official storm forecast 5d and tropical outlook 7d benchmark
retrospective 3D physical fields subject to data availability latency
cloud top rapid imagery and nowcast exploratory

gates.G0: strict source custody, data rights, acquisition and availability times; reject missing as zero
gates.G1: 14d probabilistic regional climate favorability versus ECMWF/NHC/climatology and historical independent outcomes
gates.G2: train/validation/test split by storm/basin/season/year, avoid same-storm contamination
gates.G3: Brier/CRPS/log score, reliability, uncertainty intervals, false alarms vs climatology
gates.G4: ablate 51/52y, lunar/planetary, archaeological clock, Juno, TEC and information features; retain only independent gains
gates.G5: 30min pressure/wind tendencies need real sensor as-of latency and separate event validation
gates.G6: independent meteorological review and no operational/public warnings

epistemic_boundary: Compression from SCD1 is an information science analogy; no atmospheric physical-coupling; 52yr calendar != 52yr gravity period
